# FWAAH! — Fake World Assets at home

> Live dashboard for the FWA main pools on Ethereum mainnet: deposit a whitelisted NFT with ETH backing, or pay the pull fee for a random NFT from the pool. Two pools are live — **V2** (since 2026-09-16, the default everywhere here) and the legacy **V1** (still running; `?pool=v1`). fwaah.com is an open-source, self-hostable fork-at-home client — it never holds keys; wallets sign everything.

Agents: start with the skill, then poll the snapshot.

## Agent resources

- [Agent skill](https://fwaah.com/skill.md): paste this into your agent (Claude Code skill format, plain markdown). It explains the game's mechanics, the live snapshot's fields, contract addresses, ABIs, selectors, and event topics for going on-chain directly.
- [Live data snapshot — V2](https://fwaah.com/livedatasnapshot.json): the whole pool state as one pre-decoded JSON document — pool stats, pull price, rules/knobs, oracle ceiling, purchase blackout clock, rewards epochs, whitelist (+ oracle exemptions), the Crown. Edge-cached ~60s; poll it freely.
- [Live data snapshot — V1](https://fwaah.com/livedatasnapshot.json?pool=v1): same document for the legacy pool (fixed emission schedule instead of epochs).

## Reference

- [Official FWA docs](https://www.fwa.fun/docs): the protocol's own documentation (vocabulary: the Crown, crown tithe, oracle ceiling, cold windows). [V2 explained](https://www.fwa.fun/v2) · [V2 deployments](https://www.fwa.fun/docs/v2-deployments) · [V1 guide](https://www.fwa.fun/docs/v1)
- [Verified V2 core source + ABI (Sourcify)](https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/1/0x958C41181182e76F221331b2755b77D9e1426A98?fields=sources,abi)
- [Verified V1 core source + ABI (Sourcify)](https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/1/0xB276F62DB0ce8CA2Ca5bc522695bE604521eAc1c?fields=sources,abi)
